summary: The bodiless Old God of the north: servants nobody names, the black islands, the deathless dead, the rising and the brief form.

veiled_service.name: Veiled Service
veiled_service.desc: The service is given quietly. No banner is raised and no name is spoken, and the north goes on being quiet.

open_service.name: Service Unhidden
open_service.desc: The service is given openly. It cannot be described, but it can be seen, and the north grows stronger for it.

servants_at_war_spirit.name: Servants at War
servants_at_war_spirit.desc: The orders go to war beside the dead, and their work is seen in the ranks.

faceless_seat.name: A Seat Without a Face
faceless_seat.desc: Furviatlon is kept. It has a hand and a voice, and no face.

faceless_seat_2.name: The Seat Endures
faceless_seat_2.desc: The seat endures. It has been strong before, and it will be strong again.

unpeopled_land.name: The Unpeopled Land
unpeopled_land.desc: The land has no people. A garrison is a small thing in a country that has no one to garrison.

black_hulls_spirit.name: Black Hulls
black_hulls_spirit.desc: Hulls of black wood sail without crews that can be seen. They keep station in the dark and do not tire.

landing_grounds_spirit.name: Landing Grounds
landing_grounds_spirit.desc: Flat, dark landing grounds lie ready on shores no one visits.

out_of_the_isles_spirit.name: Out of the Isles
out_of_the_isles_spirit.desc: The dead come out of the isles over water that is not frozen and through fog that has no end.

through_the_straits.name: Through Islands and Straits
through_the_straits.desc: No chart records the way the dead come south, through islands and through straits.

deathless_1.name: The Deathless
deathless_1.desc: These are not the dead of the old tales. They do not wail, they do not wander, and they do not forget their orders.

deathless_2.name: Shapes Broken, Not Ended
deathless_2.desc: A shape that is broken is not ended. It is gathered, mended and put back into the line.

deathless_3.name: Deathless Endurance
deathless_3.desc: The dead do not tire and now they do not break. Their line holds through blows that would turn a living army.

no_hunger.name: No Hunger, No Cold
no_hunger.desc: They feel neither hunger nor cold. A march that would kill a living army is for them only a march.

tireless.name: The Tireless March
tireless.desc: The march continues through the night and the day, and the dead reach the end of their road without having rested.

great_host.name: The Great Host
great_host.desc: The Great Host is vast, silent and numbered by the hundred, and it faces south.

death_marches.name: Death Marches South
death_marches.desc: Death marches south. The roads lie empty before it and the living huddle behind their walls.

strike_while_they_sleep_spirit.name: Strike While They Sleep
strike_while_they_sleep_spirit.desc: The south sleeps and the dead do not. A blow struck now will land before the sleepers wake.

against_the_middle_kingdom.name: Against the Middle Kingdom
against_the_middle_kingdom.desc: The dead march south against the Golden Kingdom. The road is open and there is no one to stop them.

alone_against_all_spirit.name: Alone Against All
alone_against_all_spirit.desc: The north takes no ally. Every living thing and every other dark is its enemy.

long_war.name: The Long War of the Dead
long_war.desc: The war of the dead does not end in a season. It ends when the dead decide to stop.

patience.name: The Patient Dark
patience.desc: The dark is patient. It has waited since before the first king and can wait for the last.

patience_2.name: A Presence Vast and Quiet
patience_2.desc: The presence is vast and quiet. It does not move, it does not speak, and it fills the whole of the north.

presence_takes_form.name: The Servant Takes the Field
presence_takes_form.desc: His most loyal servant stands on the field, vast and dark and silent, and the ground he stands upon goes quiet around him.

reluctance_of_gods.title: The Reluctance of Gods
reluctance_of_gods.desc: Some of the younger gods give less than they gave. No one can say why. The presence feels the difference as a draught in a closed room.

older_than_kings.title: Older Than Kings
older_than_kings.desc: The north was old before the first crown of men was forged. The presence remembers, and the cold remembers with it.

the_wanderers.title: Those Who Wander
the_wanderers.desc: The dead walk the wastes. Whose they are is not known, and none of the living has asked them.

first_host.title: The First Host
first_host.desc: Ranks stand in the black at Šodolôro and do not tire. They are numbered, they are silent, and they face the south.

old_roads.title: The Old Roads of Power
old_roads.desc: Paths long prepared lie open beneath the ice. How they were laid, and by whom, is not told.

what_the_war_leaves.title: What the War Leaves
what_the_war_leaves.desc: The war of the living has filled the fields with dead. The north is closer to them now than it has ever been.

a_greater_hour.title: A Greater Hour
a_greater_hour.desc: Not yet. Not for years. The hour is greater than the first, and the north will wait for it.

unending_patience.title: The Unending Patience
unending_patience.desc: The north will not rise in this age unless it is struck. It is content, and it asks for nothing from the living.

options.name: Let the living have their age.

wounded_not_slain.title: Wounded, Not Slain
wounded_not_slain.desc: The servant came back into the dark of the north with a shard of the blue sword in his side. He was wounded and he was not slain, and the north has outlasted worse.

another_age.title: Matters for Another Age
another_age.desc: The age turns. The north is silent, and it waits.

focuses.name: Servants Unseen
focuses.desc: The service continues, as it always has, out of sight. It is neither asked nor told, and the north does not speak of it.

focuses.name: The Great Who Serve
focuses.desc: The oldest of the orders gives what it gives. Its weight is felt in the cold, in the stillness and in the length of the nights.

focuses.name: The Lesser Multitude
focuses.desc: The lesser orders are many, and their labours are small. Together they hold up the long dark.

focuses.name: Gods Who Serve an Older God
focuses.desc: Younger gods have bent their knees to an older god. Why they have done so is not recorded.

focuses.name: Old Strength Bent to Service
focuses.desc: Strength that once ruled is turned, without complaint, to a quieter use. The north does not ask for gratitude.

focuses.name: Labours of the Lesser
focuses.desc: The lesser labour in places where no one goes, and their work is seen only when it is not done.

focuses.name: The Reluctance of Gods
focuses.desc: Not every god gives gladly. Some give little, some give late, and some give nothing at all.

focuses.name: The Tending
focuses.desc: The presence must be tended as a fire is tended in winter. It requires patience, a steady hand and no thanks.

focuses.name: Orders Apart
focuses.desc: The three orders are kept apart, as water is kept from pitch. What each gives, none of the others learns.

focuses.name: The Divine Keep Their Silence
focuses.desc: The younger gods say nothing of what they give. Silence is their only gift and their entire courtesy.

focuses.name: A Concealed Allegiance
focuses.desc: Those who serve do so quietly. No banner is raised and no name is spoken, and the north goes on being quiet.

focuses.name: Service Without Shame
focuses.desc: Those who serve do so openly. Their names are not written, but their work is seen, and the north grows stronger for it.

focuses.name: The Great Bear the Weight
focuses.desc: The great bear the heaviest portion without being asked. They stand beneath it as pillars stand beneath a roof.

focuses.name: When Servants Falter
focuses.desc: Service sometimes fails. A bond that is lost may return, if it is waited for and not demanded.

focuses.name: Service Without End
focuses.desc: The service has no term. It was not asked for a season, and it will not be released at the end of one.

focuses.name: The Whole Service
focuses.desc: All three orders give together, and the north grows heavy with it. The presence deepens, and the cold deepens with it.

focuses.name: Servants at War
focuses.desc: The orders go to war beside the dead. Their work is seen in the ranks, and it is not described.

focuses.name: The Silence of the North
focuses.desc: The north is silent, and the silence is not empty. A presence that has no body, no court and no name fills the cold with its patience.

focuses.name: It Grows Each Day
focuses.desc: It grows, slowly, each day. No one remarks on it, because no one is looking.

focuses.name: Against the Fading
focuses.desc: The Fading erodes what is old. The presence leans against it and, for a time, holds.

focuses.name: What Is Held, What Is Spent
focuses.desc: What is held, and what is spent, are weighed together. The presence may draw on its store, but each drawing leaves it thinner.

focuses.name: The Unanswering Magic
focuses.desc: The magic of Aoaz does not answer an older god. It is a refusal that has lasted an age, and the presence has learned to live inside it.

focuses.name: A Presence Deepened
focuses.desc: The presence deepens. It cannot be seen, but the cold has grown, and the nights are longer than they were.

focuses.name: Older Than Kings
focuses.desc: The north was old before the first crown of men was forged. What was already old does not hurry.

focuses.name: The Appointed Hour
focuses.desc: There is an hour, and it has been appointed. The north will wait for it, and rise on it, and not before.

focuses.name: The Hastened Hour
focuses.desc: The hour may be hastened, at a price. The Fading leans harder on a presence that rushes.

focuses.name: The Long Patience
focuses.desc: The north has waited an age. It may wait another, and let the living wear each other down.

focuses.name: The Seat at Furviatlon
focuses.desc: Furviatlon is a seat of stone in the north. It is occupied, and who occupies it is not known.

effects.tooltip: Who keeps the seat is not known.

focuses.name: A Seat Without a Face
focuses.desc: The seat is kept. It has a hand and a voice, and no face. Those who come to Furviatlon are not told whom they have met.

focuses.name: Šodolôro
focuses.desc: Šodolôro is a black plain on the northern shore. It is empty now, and it will not always be.

focuses.name: The Black Wastes
focuses.desc: The black wastes harden against intruders. Roads vanish, wells run dry, and the wind carries a sound like a closing door.

focuses.name: The Wandering Dead
focuses.desc: The dead walk the wastes. Whose they are is not known, and no one has been willing to ask.

focuses.name: The Seat's Long Reach
focuses.desc: The seat's reach is long. Its writ runs to the edge of the ice, and further than anyone has gone to test it.

focuses.name: The Unpeopled Land
focuses.desc: The land is without people, and it will remain so. A garrison is a small thing in a country that has no one to garrison.

focuses.name: Šodolôro Stirs
focuses.desc: Šodolôro stirs. The black plain is no longer still, and the dust moves against the wind.

focuses.name: The Seat Endures
focuses.desc: The seat endures. The north has been strong before, and it will be strong again.

focuses.name: The Black Islands
focuses.desc: The black islands lie in the cold sea and are said to be empty. Fishermen who pass them at night say otherwise.

focuses.name: Stirring Among the Isles
focuses.desc: The islands stir. Lights have been seen on their shores where no one lives.

focuses.name: Black Hulls
focuses.desc: Hulls of black wood are built in the shadow of the islands. They have no crews that can be seen, and they sail well.

focuses.name: Let Them Talk
focuses.desc: The fishermen talk of lights and shapes in the water. The north does nothing to stop them, and the tales spread.

focuses.name: Keep the Isles Dark
focuses.desc: The islands are kept dark. Fishermen who stray near them are turned back by fog, and their tales die in the harbour.

focuses.name: The Outer Arc
focuses.desc: The outer arc of islands is woken. The sea between them is black, and no ship that enters it keeps its course.

focuses.name: Hulls Without Living Crews
focuses.desc: The hulls sail without living crews. They keep station in the dark, and they do not tire.

focuses.name: The Island Hosts
focuses.desc: Ranks stand on the islands, in the black, facing the sea. They do not move and they do not speak.

focuses.name: Toward the Straits
focuses.desc: The hulls turn toward the straits. The chart-makers of the south have no names for the water they will cross.

focuses.name: Every Black Isle
focuses.desc: Every black isle wakes. The sea is full of them, and none can be told from another.

focuses.name: Landing Grounds
focuses.desc: Landing grounds are prepared on shores no one visits. They are flat, dark and ready.

focuses.name: The Black Fleet
focuses.desc: The black fleet is assembled in the dark. Its hulls are many, its crews are none, and its course is set.

focuses.name: Out of the Isles
focuses.desc: The dead come out of the isles. They walk on water that is not frozen and pass through fog that has no end.

focuses.name: Through Islands and Straits
focuses.desc: Through islands and through straits, the dead come south. No chart records the way.

focuses.name: The Dead of Zol
focuses.desc: The dead of Zol lie in the black and the cold, and they do not decay. They have been waiting for a long time.

focuses.name: Not as Elzon's Dead
focuses.desc: These are not the dead of the old tales. They do not wail, they do not wander, and they do not forget their orders.

focuses.name: The Fallen Return
focuses.desc: The fallen return, in their time. A fallen soldier of the north is a soldier waiting to be raised.

focuses.name: Shapes Broken, Not Ended
focuses.desc: A shape that is broken is not ended. It is gathered, mended and put back into the line.

focuses.name: No Hunger, No Cold
focuses.desc: They feel neither hunger nor cold. A march that would kill a living army is for them only a march.

focuses.name: Grave Arms
focuses.desc: Arms are taken from the graves of the old wars, cleaned, balanced and handed out. They have been waiting too.

focuses.name: The First Host
focuses.desc: The First Host stands on the black plain. Its ranks are even, its banners are numbered, and it does not tire.

focuses.name: The Grave March
focuses.desc: The dead are taught to march in ranks, at an even pace, for days at a time. They learn easily.

focuses.name: Deathless Endurance
focuses.desc: The dead do not tire, and now they do not break. Their line holds through blows that would turn a living army.

focuses.name: The Tireless March
focuses.desc: The march continues through the night and the day. The dead reach the end of their road and find that they have not rested.

focuses.name: The Gathered Hosts
focuses.desc: The hosts are gathered, rank by rank, on the plains of the north. They are numbered, and they wait.

focuses.name: What Can End Them
focuses.desc: The dead can be ended, though not by ordinary weapons. Only potent magic ends them, and the north knows it.

effects.tooltip: Only potent magic can end them.

focuses.name: The Dead Rise Armed
focuses.desc: The dead rise, armed and in order. Another host is added to the ranks and takes its place without being told.

focuses.name: The Great Host
focuses.desc: The Great Host assembles at last. It is vast, silent and numbered by the hundred, and it faces south.

focuses.name: Death Marches South
focuses.desc: Death marches south. Roads lie empty before it, and the living huddle behind their walls.

focuses.name: The Dead Rise
focuses.desc: The hour has come. The dead rise, the north opens, and the silence ends.

focuses.name: Strike While They Sleep
focuses.desc: The south sleeps, and the dead do not. A blow struck now will land before the sleepers wake.

focuses.name: Southward to Aenor
focuses.desc: The dead march south toward the Golden Kingdom. The way is long, the road is open, and there is no one to stop them.

focuses.name: The Northern Shores
focuses.desc: The dead turn to the northern shores, where the sea-kings keep their strait. They have not been warned.

focuses.name: The Edge of the Elven Woods
focuses.desc: The dead come to the edge of the elven woods. The trees watch them, and the trees do not move.

focuses.name: Two Darknesses Meet
focuses.desc: Two darknesses meet at the edge of the world. Neither retreats, and the ground between them is not recovered.

focuses.name: The Land Made Waste
focuses.desc: Where the dead have walked, nothing grows. The soil is grey, the wells are dry, and the sky is white.

focuses.name: The Brief Accord
focuses.desc: A third power has come, and two darknesses have a common foe. The north is willing to hear an offer.

focuses.name: Alone Against All
focuses.desc: The north takes no ally. Every living thing and every other dark is its enemy, and it will meet them all alone.

focuses.name: The Isles Hold
focuses.desc: The islands are fortified. Black stone is piled upon black stone, and whatever stands behind them is not seen.

focuses.name: The Long War of the Dead
focuses.desc: The war of the dead is long. It does not end in a season or a year. It ends when the dead decide to stop.

focuses.name: What the War Leaves
focuses.desc: The war has filled the fields with dead. The north is nearer to them than it was before.

focuses.name: The Patient Dark
focuses.desc: The dark is patient. It has waited since before the first king and can wait for the last.

focuses.name: Watch from the North
focuses.desc: The north watches. It sees the living build and burn and sees nothing it cannot outlast.

focuses.name: The Unwatched North
focuses.desc: The north goes unwatched. Its fires are put out, its roads are left to the snow, and the world forgets that it was ever feared.

focuses.name: Deeper Service
focuses.desc: The service deepens. What the orders give, they give more freely, and what is given is not lost.

focuses.name: A Greater Hour
focuses.desc: A greater hour than the first. The north will wait until the living are tired and the age is nearly done.

focuses.name: The Unending Patience
focuses.desc: The north will not rise in this age unless it is struck. It is content, and it asks for nothing.

focuses.name: The Late Rising
focuses.desc: The late rising comes when the age is spent. The dead walk into a world that has no more strength to resist.

focuses.name: A Presence Vast and Quiet
focuses.desc: The presence is vast and quiet. It does not move, it does not speak, and it fills the whole of the north.

focuses.name: The Old Roads of Power
focuses.desc: Old roads of power lie open beneath the ice. By whom they were laid, and for what, is not told.

focuses.name: Routes Beneath the Isles
focuses.desc: Beneath the islands, other roads run. They join and part like veins, and all of them lead south.

focuses.name: A Road Toward the South
focuses.desc: The roads of power run together toward a single point in the south. The north has begun to prepare for it.

focuses.name: The Weight of the Dead
focuses.desc: The weight of the dead is great, and it is gathered. Each fallen soldier adds to the sum.

focuses.name: When Hosts Are Broken
focuses.desc: When a host is broken, its breaking is not wasted. The presence draws on it and is stronger for the loss.

focuses.name: The Servant Called
focuses.desc: What the north can spare of its master's strength may be lent, for a short time and at a great price, to the one who serves him best, and it is not a thing to be done lightly.

focuses.name: The Price of the Field
focuses.desc: The north learns what it must give each week to keep its servant on the field, and learns to give a little less of it.

focuses.name: The Servant Takes the Field
focuses.desc: His most loyal servant stands on the field, vast and dark and silent, and the hosts that march beside him do not falter.

focuses.name: Into the Dark Again
focuses.desc: The servant has gone back into the dark he came from, wounded and silent, and the presence gathers itself again around the black isles.

focuses.name: Wounded, Not Slain
focuses.desc: His servant withdrew from the field wounded, and he was not slain, and what the north lent him comes slowly home.

focuses.name: The Mistake Endures
focuses.desc: The Mistake endures. It is smaller than it was, but it is whole, and it does not forget.

focuses.name: Matters for Another Age
focuses.desc: There are matters for another age. The north is silent now, and it waits.
